ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the horizontal axis is ωt, and the vertical axis is v(t). The waveform is a three-level quasi-square wave: at both ends of each half-cycle there is a zero-voltage interval with width σ; the middle of the positive half-cycle is a +100 V pulse, that is, from θ=σ to θ=π−σ it is +100 V; the middle of the negative half-cycle is −100 V, that is, from θ=π+σ to θ=2π−σ it is −100 V. The waveform is antisymmetric about the half-cycle, so it contains only odd sine harmonics. Then reason: let θ=ωt. Because of half-wave symmetry, for odd harmonics it is only necessary to integrate over the positive half-cycle. Within the positive half-cycle, the interval where v(θ)=100 V is σ≤θ≤π−σ, and the rest is 0. Therefore the sine coefficient for odd n is b_n=(2/π)∫_0^π v(θ)sin(nθ)dθ=(2/π)∫_σ^(π−σ)100sin(nθ)dθ. Integrating gives b_n=(200/(nπ))[cos(nσ)−cos(n(π−σ))]. For odd n, cos(n(π−σ))=−cos(nσ), so b_n=(400/(nπ))cos(nσ), namely b_n=(4·100/(nπ))cos(nσ). The problem requires completely eliminating the 3rd harmonic, so b_3=0, namely cos(3σ)=0. Within the effective switching range, take 3σ=π/2, therefore σ=π/6. The percentage of the 5th harmonic amplitude relative to the fundamental amplitude is 100×|b_5/b_1|=100×|(400/(5π))cos(5σ)| / |(400/π)cos(σ)| = 100×|cos(5π/6)|/(5|cos(π/6)|). Since |cos(5π/6)|=√3/2 and |cos(π/6)|=√3/2, the ratio is 100×1/5=20%.

题设要求完全消除 3 次谐波，所以 b_3=0，即 cos(3σ)=0。在有效开关范围内取 3σ=π/2，因此 σ=π/6。
